data.one_liner: Utility to bind keyboard key combinations to callbacks in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides KeyCode, Keybinding, and Keybinder classes to represent physical keys, define key combinations, and invoke callbacks when those combinations are pressed or released. Works across all Flutter platforms using the global RawKeyboard/HardwareKeyboard API.
use_when: Implement keyboard shortcuts or hotkeys in a Flutter app
Need cross‑platform raw key detection without writing boilerplate
avoid_when: App runs only on touch‑only devices with no keyboard
Require complex chord or sequence handling beyond simple combos
strengths: Simple, declarative API for key bindings
Works on Android, iOS, web, desktop
Supports inclusive and exclusive binding modes
weaknesses: No UI components for displaying shortcuts
Limited to single‑key or simple combination detection
No advanced chord or macro features
